observed: Critical browser smoke intermittently timed out after dispatching a chosen local file while the initial repository source was still resolving.
cause: openLocalFile reserved sourceEpoch+1 without incrementing sourceEpoch before awaiting file.text(); a concurrent source load could reach that epoch and make the local file self-cancel.
delta: Increment sourceEpoch synchronously when local file intake begins; abort older source work by epoch mismatch; after file.text(), proceed only if the local-file epoch is still current.
invariants: No upload or repository write is introduced.
Existing READFIELD address/focus semantics remain unchanged.
next: Merge only if the existing local-file browser smoke and full public-surface suite pass.
